data.description:

Our psychologist believe Abby feels she is unwanted and unlovable as a fact of life, and lashes out at everyone close to her as a self-defense mechanism.

Treatment - A special leash and shock collar has been provided, the collar placed around the neck of Abby, while the controller has been given to the victim.
